standalone_query.description: The visitor's latest message rewritten as one complete, self-contained question.

language.description: Language of the visitor's latest message: English or Bahasa Indonesia.

intent.description: info = asks about the tutoring; booking = wants to book, enquire or get in touch; smalltalk = greeting or thanks; off_topic = unrelated to the tutoring service.

needs_retrieval.description: True when answering needs facts about the tutor or the service.
